source_metadata.title: High-dose intravenous vitamin C, a promising multi-targeting agent in the treatment of cancer
source_metadata.journal: Journal of Experimental & Clinical Cancer Research
source_metadata.design: narrative review with targeted literature searches for selected preclinical and clinical subsets
source_metadata.source_scope_warning: This review summarizes heterogeneous preclinical and clinical literature. Results from cited studies are secondary reports and should be checked in the primary publications before reuse as primary evidence.

sections_or_headings.heading: High-dose VitC as a single agent
Global molecular profiling studies on high-dose IVC in cancer context

figures.title: Study overview of preclinical, clinical and omics studies using high-dose VitC
figures.key_content: Maps study types, vitamin C dose ranges, main reported preclinical effects, completed clinical outcomes, and omics-study counts.

figures.title: High-dose VitC as an adjuvant in anticancer combinations
figures.key_content: Maps 59 anticancer agents across 71 preclinical studies and summarizes combination type, vitamin C dose, exposure schedule and solvent.

figures.title: Cancer types in published and ongoing clinical trials
figures.key_content: Maps 34 published and 23 ongoing trials as of February 2021, including dose range and treatment type. Tables 2 and 3 detail the medium-to-high-dose subsets.

figures.title: Mechanisms of action reported in recent combination studies
figures.key_content: Groups mechanistic effects reported in 45 combinations from 2016 to 2021, including redox, metabolic, epigenetic and immune effects.

figures.title: Global molecular profiling studies of vitamin C in cancer
figures.key_content: Maps cancer types, vitamin C dose groups, profiling methods and mono-versus-combination treatment context.

figures.title: Multifaceted anticancer effects of high-dose VitC
figures.key_content: Integrates the best-known and emerging proposed mechanisms into one conceptual schematic.

tables.title: Combinations of anticancer agents and high-dose VitC in preclinical studies
tables.key_content: Summarizes 44 recent preclinical studies and 47 combinations, with models, doses, schedules and reported interaction effects.

tables.title: Published medium-to-high-dose IVC clinical studies
tables.key_content: Details 16 published studies, including dose, schedule, pharmacokinetics, cancer type, co-therapy, outcomes and toxicity.

tables.title: Ongoing medium-to-high-dose IVC clinical studies
tables.key_content: Details 16 ongoing medium-to-high-dose trials at the review cutoff, with cancer type, intervention, phase and status.

tables.title: Global molecular profiling studies in cancer context
tables.key_content: Catalogs proteomic, transcriptomic and metabolomic studies, doses, models and principal molecular findings.
